description:
Brand Introduction

HJE's & YOU is an innovative eCommerce store specializing in eco-friendly, comfortable, and reliable period underwear. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people experience their menstrual cycles by offering sustainable, stylish, and leak-proof solutions for everyday comfort.

Our brand stands for inclusivity, sustainability, and empowerment—helping individuals feel confident and secure during their periods while reducing waste.

Product Description

Our period underwear is designed to combine style, comfort, and functionality. Key features include:

  • Leak-proof Technology: Multi-layer absorption for up to X hours of protection.
  • Comfort-First Design: Soft, breathable fabrics for a barely-there feel.
  • Sustainable Materials: Made with eco-friendly and reusable materials, reducing reliance on disposable period products.
  • Range of Styles: Available in various cuts (e.g., bikini, hipster, high-waist) and sizes to suit every body type.
  • Washable and Durable: Designed to last, saving money and reducing landfill waste.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

  • Sustainability: A zero-waste alternative to disposable pads and tampons.
  • Affordability: Competitive pricing without compromising on quality.
  • Inclusivity: Sizes for all body types and neutral branding for anyone who menstruates.
  • Customer-Centric Design: Focused on comfort, style, and performance to ensure a confident experience.
  • Eco-Minded Community: Empowering individuals to make sustainable choices while supporting menstrual health education.

Payment Terms for Affiliates

  • Commission Rate: Earn 10%-20% per sale (adjustable based on performance and campaigns).
  • Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid monthly via PayPal or direct bank transfer.
  • Cookie Duration: 30-day cookie tracking ensures affiliates get credited for referred sales even if customers purchase later.
  • Bonuses: Additional rewards for top performers, such as higher commission rates or exclusive product bundles.

Other Information

    • Exclusive discount codes for their audience.

  • Affiliate Perks:

    • Free or discounted products for personal use.
    • Early access to new launches and seasonal promotions.
    • Featured opportunities on our website and social media.

  • Program Requirements:

    • Affiliates must have an engaged audience (blog, social media, or email list).
    • Content must align with HJE's & YOU  values, focusing on sustainability, inclusivity, and menstrual health.

2. Affiliate Responsibilities

2.1 Affiliates are responsible for promoting HJE's & YOU in a lawful and ethical manner.

2.2 Affiliates may not engage in deceptive advertising, spam, or any other practices that may harm our brand.

3. Commission and Payment

5.1 Either party may terminate this agreement at any time with or without cause by providing written notice.

 5.2 Upon termination, affiliates must immediately cease using all promotional materials and remove any references to HJE's & YOU.

6. Limitation of Liability

HJE's & YOU is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the affiliate program.

7. Amendments

We reserve the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of significant changes via email or the affiliate portal.
